column5: The frame prints "145 SOL" and "+23" against a Solana glyph. NO SOURCE AT ANY PRICE, and it is not an effort gap: this product has no Solana wallet identity (the Thirdweb embedded wallet IS the login) and trench never settles a Solana swap - OrderPanel.execute (OrderPanel.tsx:100-110) NAVIGATES, to the in-app curve route or the token's own deep-link. With no fill there is no cost basis. poolTrades.ts is per-POOL with a 300-row / ~24h ceiling and cannot enumerate the pairs a wallet touched; alchemy-proxy allowlists alchemy_getAssetTransfers but only for eth-mainnet/base-mainnet and transfers carry no execution price. The card renders the settlement currency and says so in a scope note rather than inventing a SOL figure.

Relation DEPLOYED, writer EXISTS (savePortfolioSnapshot, crossChainPortfolioService.ts:375) but its only caller is CrossChainPortfolioAnalytics.tsx:112, which writes one row when a user happens to open that panel. Measured live 2026-08-26: portfolio_snapshots holds 0 rows. Ask = a scheduled snapshot writer, NOT a migration - filing it as a missing relation would send someone to write DDL for a table that already exists. Band renders the reason and draws NO polyline; a flat baseline would assert a balance that never moved. The verdict comes from a real PostgREST response via classifyPnlRelationFailure, so it self-corrects the day rows land.
